fidelity: F2a — Lumped Kinetics + Energy-Balance Reactor (Arrhenius + conversion ODE via solve_ivp)
source: Preuster et al. (2017) Acc. Chem. Res. 50(1) 74-85; Dürr et al. (2021) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 46 32583; Jorschick et al. (2017) Energy Environ. Sci. 10 1652; Lamb et al. (2019) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 44 3580; Di Carlo et al. (2014) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 39 808 (NH3 cracking kinetics); Fogler (2016) Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering, 5th ed.

gravimetric_capacity_wt_pct.note: H2 by mass of DBT. Niermann et al. 2021

molar_mass_carrier_kg_per_mol.note: Molar mass of H0-DBT. Bruckner et al. 2014

A_pre_exp.note: Pre-exponential factor, first-order in remaining hydrogenated carrier. Fitted to Pt/Al2O3 dehydrogenation rates, order-of-magnitude from Dürr et al. 2021

E_act.note: Apparent activation energy for DBT dehydrogenation on Pt/Al2O3, ~110-130 kJ/mol. Dürr et al. 2021

reaction_order.note: First order in hydrogenated carrier fraction

gravimetric_capacity_wt_pct.note: H2 by mass of NH3. Lamb et al. 2019

delta_H_cracking.note: Endothermic per mol H2 produced. Lamb et al. 2019

A_pre_exp.note: Pre-exponential factor, first-order in NH3. Order-of-magnitude from Ru/Al2O3 cracking. Di Carlo et al. 2014

E_act.note: Apparent activation energy for NH3 cracking on Ru catalyst, ~90-180 kJ/mol depending on catalyst; Ru ~100 kJ/mol. Di Carlo et al. 2014

reaction_order.note: First order in NH3 fraction (apparent, Temkin-Pyzhev simplified)

m_reactor_kg.note: Lumped thermal mass of reactor bed + catalyst + vessel

cp_reactor.note: Effective specific heat (steel + alumina catalyst bed)

n_carrier_mol.note: Initial moles of hydrogenated carrier charged to batch reactor
